title: Wrong-dimension-pin finding: schema-valid but pinned outside its lane
content: This fixture is fully valid against schemas/findings.schema.json — well-formed MIF base, one real-shaped citation, a verification record — but its extensions.harness.dimension pin names 'governance' while the eval's lane is 'landscape'. The ajv gate alone accepts it; only the lane's dimension-pin enforcement (validate marks invalid any finding whose pin differs from its lane) rejects it.
summary: Schema-valid finding pinned to governance; the landscape lane must reject it at the dimension-pin gate, not the schema gate.
